project.newConfirmBody: The current edit will be deleted. Your media stays in "My media" and can be reused.

onboarding.title: New reel
onboarding.templateHint: Ready-made settings to drop onto your edit.

step1.label: Import images & video
step1.hint: Photos and videos from your phone.

step2.label: Import audio
step2.hint: A file, or a built-in loop.

step3.label: Edit · analyse the rhythm
step3.hint: Locks the montage to the beat automatically.

pitch.title: BeatApp
lines: Take full control of your Reels and video clips.
Simple, fast, and easy to use.
Everything is processed directly on your smartphone.
Export unlimited MP4 videos with audio.
100% free — no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.

edit.title: Edit
edit.selectPrompt: Pick the shot you want to change.
edit.cropHint: Pinch the preview to zoom in or out, drag to move the image.
edit.deleteConfirmBody: The shot is removed from the timeline. The media stays in your library.
edit.deleteAndCloseHint: Later shots move up. The timeline gets shorter.
edit.deleteLeaveGapHint: Nothing moves: audio and text stay in sync with what follows.

preview.label: Reel preview
preview.safeAreaHint: Instagram's interface covers the edges. Keep text inside the frame.
preview.empty: Add photos or videos to get started
preview.framingCrop: The edges fall outside the frame and will be cropped
preview.framingGap: {{percent}}% of the frame is left empty

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.followOn: Make audio and text follow when a clip is deleted
timeline.followOff: Keep audio and text in place when a clip is deleted

media.title: Media
media.colorsHint: A solid background works as a title card, a separator, or a backdrop for text.
media.reelHint: Reuse an existing reel: it is split into shots, and its sound lands on an adjustable track.
media.reelMethodBeatHint: The reel's sound is analysed, and cuts land on the beats.
media.reelMethodSceneHint: Detects real picture changes and cuts at the same spots.
media.reelReplaceWarn: The current edit will be replaced by the imported reel.
media.reelNoCuts: No cut found: the reel arrives as a single shot.
media.reelSocialNote: Instagram and TikTok links don't work. Save the video to your camera roll first, then import the file.
media.myMediaHint: These stay from one reel to the next. "New" doesn't delete them.
media.clearLibraryHint_one: {{count}} item will be removed from the list. Anything already placed in an edit stays there.
media.clearLibraryHint_other: {{count}} items will be removed from the list. Anything already placed in an edit stays there.
media.emptyHint: Import photos, videos, or an existing reel.
media.assetInUse: This media is used in the timeline.

originalAudio.title: Keep the video's sound?
originalAudio.body_one: This video has sound. Do you want to use it in the reel?
originalAudio.body_other: {{count}} of the videos you imported have sound. Do you want to use it in the reel?
originalAudio.hint: The sound goes on its own track: you can set its volume or delete it from the Audio tab.

audio.title: Audio
audio.emptyHint: Import an audio file or pick a sample.
audio.trendingNote: For trending audio, export first, then add the sound inside Instagram.
audio.rangeHint: Drag the handles on the waveform, or use the sliders.
audio.cutHint: Cut, then delete the part you don't want.
audio.removeSegmentClose: Delete this part and close the gap
audio.removeSegmentGap: Delete this part and leave silence
audio.syncHint: Shift the music so the first beat lands on your shot.
audio.cannotEdit: File length unknown, so it can't be edited.

url.title: Import from a link
url.label: File address
url.hint: Direct link to a .mp4, .jpg or .mp3 file.
url.socialWarning: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube links won't work: those sites block downloads from a browser. Save the video to your camera roll first, then import it as a file.

mask.title: Text mask
mask.hint: The edit shows through the letters; everything else is covered.
mask.contentHint: One or two letters give the best result.

text.title: Text
text.removeLeaveGap: Delete this text and leave its place empty
text.removeClose: Delete this text and move later ones up

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.paste: Paste the lyrics, one line per phrase
lyrics.placeholder:
First line
Second line
Third line
lyrics.noBeatMap: Without beat analysis, lines are spread evenly. Analyse the beat for accurate timing.
lyrics.aiNote: Paste your lyrics — the timing is worked out for you. Three other input methods are available above.
lyrics.karaokeWords: Word-level accuracy: the timings come from the model.
lyrics.karaokeSweep: Even sweep: without per-word timings, progress follows the line's duration.
lyrics.fileHint: A .lrc or .srt file already carries its timings, so they're used as they are.
lyrics.songOffsetHint: The reel runs {{duration}}. Enter which second of the song it starts at.
lyrics.micHint: Sing or speak while the reel plays: each phrase is stamped at the moment you say it, so it's already in time. The microphone goes through the browser's speech recognition service.
lyrics.aiWarning: This sends your audio to the service you pick. It's the only part of the app that transmits data off your device.
lyrics.groqRole: Transcribes audio and returns a time for every phrase: the timing comes from the model, so it's the most accurate.
lyrics.geminiRole: Transcribes audio into plain text. Lines are then snapped to the detected beats.
lyrics.timedNote_one: {{count}} phrase timed by the model. Those times will be used as they are.
lyrics.timedNote_other: {{count}} phrases timed by the model. Those times will be used as they are.
lyrics.timedLost: The text was edited, so the model's times no longer match. Timing will fall back to the detected beats.
lyrics.apiKeyHint: Your key stays on this device and is only ever sent to the service you pick.

effects.title: Effects
effects.clearClip: Remove all effects from this clip
effects.clearAllClips: Remove all effects from the edit

beat.title: Beat
beat.criterionBeatHint: One shot per beat: steady, locked to the rhythm.
beat.criterionOnsetsHint: One shot per real hit: follows the playing, not the metronome.
beat.criterionDynamicsHint: Shots change when the music rises or drops.
beat.criterionSectionsHint: One shot per part: verse, chorus, bridge.
beat.distributeHint: Each clip will last exactly one beat.
